## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Shomli Interiors?
1st Floor, Plot 4 & 5, Agaram Main Road, Sri Ranganathan Nagar Road, Selaiyur, Chennai 600 073.

### What facilities does Shomli Interiors have?
Corporate offices, Colleges & schools, Hospitals, Retail showrooms, Jewellery stores, Textile stores, Restaurants, Hotels & resorts, 2D layouts & 3D walkthroughs, AC & electrical drawings, Free design consultation.

### Do you have your own factory?
Yes. Three units in Moulivakkam (wood, metal and MS) with CNC, beam saw and laser cutting machines.

### What kinds of spaces do you do?
Corporate offices, colleges, hospitals, retail and jewellery showrooms, textile stores, restaurants, hotels and resorts.

### How do I book a site visit with Shomli Interiors?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 97898 72527.
